Rivals.

Manchester United is our main rival. We hate each other with passion. The clubs are the two most successful teams in England. Both cities are also very close and that only adds to the tension. Its not only rivalry between the clubs, it’s also rivalry between the two cities.

Everton FC aka Merseyside derby. It’s a local derby. It’s considered the friendly derby because of the large number of families with both Liverpool and Everton supporters.
